images.prompt: Flat vector logo artwork. CRITICAL: the deep oxblood red background colour must fill the ENTIRE canvas edge to edge, touching all four edges of the square. Do NOT draw any border, outline, stripe, green edge, keyline, card, frame, rounded container, drop shadow, or margin around the artwork — the previous attempt wrongly added a green border strip around all four sides, which is forbidden. Centered on that unbroken oxblood field: a bold bright green apple silhouette with a large bite taken out of its right side, the bite edge shaped like a human jaw with visible teeth, and below it a chunky beveled routed-wood-sign banner carrying cream 1990s casual-dining signage lettering. The only text anywhere in the image is exactly: APPLEBEEZ

Cinematic wide interior photograph of a suburban American bar and grill at 4pm, completely empty. Rows of green vinyl booths with sticky laminate tables, Tiffany-style stained-glass hanging lamps, walls crowded floor to ceiling with antique tin signs, old bicycles, lacrosse sticks and sports memorabilia, a dozen televisions mounted everywhere all showing the identical frozen frame. Dim green-and-amber bar lighting with cold blue television flicker as fill, slightly grimy, nostalgic 1998 casual dining. Camera: 24mm wide, eye level down the center aisle, deep focus, filmic contrast, faint haze. Deadpan hyperreal cinematic realism. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.
